notes: The source matches the served counts and denominators: Omega-3 166/7740 and Placebo Omega-3 135/7740. Counts are participants with fatal or non-fatal events, not episode counts. In this outcome, OG000 is Omega-3 and OG001 is Placebo Omega-3; these group IDs have different meanings in other outcomes. Omega-3 combines Omega-3+Aspirin and Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin; Placebo Omega-3 combines Placebo Omega-3+Aspirin and Placebo Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin. Each component arm is described as containing 3870 participants; separate atrial fibrillation counts for those four factorial arms are NOT_IN_PACKET. Denominators are explicitly stated in the outcome denoms, but their population basis is not explicitly qualified there. Arm-specific atrial fibrillation percentages are NOT_IN_PACKET.
